subject.title: [Feature]: Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan as a bundled qwen provider/auth surface, or should this remain outside core/bundled plugins?
rationale: The request fits the model-provider roadmap, but it adds public provider, auth-choice, env-var, endpoint, and catalog contracts that AGENTS.md treats as product and compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Accept Bundled Token Plan Provider
options.body: Review and repair the linked PR until qwen-token-plan is cleanly represented in manifest, docs, generated catalogs, and tests, then merge it as an official bundled provider.

options.title: Route To External Plugin
options.body: Ask the contributor to publish Token Plan support as an external provider plugin if maintainers do not want to own another Alibaba provider contract in the bundled qwen plugin.

options.title: Defer Until More Vendor Proof
options.body: Keep the issue open but pause the PR until maintainers have stronger Alibaba documentation or account-level proof for the provider ids, regions, and model catalog.

recommendation.title: Accept Bundled Token Plan Provider
recommendation.body: Review and repair the linked PR until qwen-token-plan is cleanly represented in manifest, docs, generated catalogs, and tests, then merge it as an official bundled provider.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the qwen provider surface and is the clearest routing owner for the bundled-provider product boundary.
